question: On the one original fixed first global64 batch, does the first observed original-threshold failure occur in a named complete-model linear dW with identical logical X/G operands under B64 versus sequential32+32 grouping?
falsification: No threshold failure in this fixed batch: report no failure observed within this scope and stop; do not add batches or seeds.
Earlier output/G/dX/native/nonlinear/db difference or missing operand identity: same-operand direct-KML-dW localization is not established.
Identical logical X/G and a failing dW on a verified route support only that named grouping-sensitive operation; they do not establish a candidate fix, exact kernel or actual DDP result.
purpose: Baseline localization only. Sequential32+32 is a diagnostic control; original fullB64/fp32 remains the sole reference.

fixed_data.mask_rule: One original64x208 draw from a private generator holding original post-model-initialization RNG state; reuse its two slices. No seed0 shortcut, reseed, resampling or extra draw.
fixed_data.target_gradient_rule: v and image require gradients as in original train_step. v is also voltage target and image generates coarse target; do not detach either target. Angles/belt remain fixed non-gradient original tensors.

paths.description: One unchanged complete Encoder+both-heads fullB64 forward/backward at original seed0 initial state. Use frozen engineering_training.losses mean expressions unchanged and call backward once; never call train_step/B64Reference.advance because they execute optimizer.step. Retain necessary output/input/parameter-gradient reference tensors; record frozen first-step losses under original compare.

Restore same byte-identical initial parameters/buffers and required RNG from one in-memory initial snapshot, zero gradients once. Process original first32 then last32; independent input leaves and original mask slices; accumulate raw parameter gradients on the same model without intermediate zeroing. No second model copy or optimizer state is needed.

scaling.reference: Original frozen F.mse_loss mean expressions from engineering_training.losses, including head_v and head_coarse; do not rewrite full reference into sum/divisor.
scaling.sequential: Each shard uses its local voltage/coarse SSE divided by the two original global denominators separately. Sum backward contributions; local multiplier1, parameter gradient divisor1, input gradient divisor1.
scaling.voltage_denominator: Actual count of true values in the one original real-data64x208 mask; record both local counts and their sum. Do not use Tiny count4.
scaling.zero_global_denominator: Reject without resampling or epsilon; local empty masked sum stays differentiable.
scaling.future_DDP_contract: world2 would use local multiplier2/default parameter averaging/input divisor2. This spec has no DDP, so it must not apply those factors.

observation.logical_hash_rule: Canonicalize by original sample IDs and actual batch axis, not first half of flattened rows. Internal attention projections can be token-major. Missing/unprovable row mapping blocks inference; never sort numerical values or compare mismatched shapes as if aligned.
observation.X_G_capture: Observe actual forward X and actual output-adjoint G transiently. Compare per-logical-shard bytes/hashes; no full-layer X/G snapshots persist. Hash equality is the required exact-operand evidence; hashes differing mean upstream/localization remains limited.
observation.dX_capture: Observe actual operator VJP via a reviewed passive return/node observer on the installed2.7.1 autograd path, not a combined tensor-leaf gradient when shared by multiple consumers. No extra autograd.grad/backward/GEMM. Intentional pos dX=None is recorded with needs_input_grad=false. If actual per-operation VJP cannot be observed without recomputation, block this requirement rather than synthesize it.
observation.dW_db_capture: Retain one B64 set of all153 reference gradients. Compare sequential accumulated canonical gradients and bias gradients with original compare; no second division. Record direct call role and per-shard VJP metadata where naturally available. db is Torch reduction, not a direct _sgemm call.
observation.extra_boundaries: Encoder input/output,12 block boundaries and both heads: hashes only to bound the earliest observed forward/adjoint difference; do not claim an instruction trace.
observation.required_tensor_values: FullB64 reference h/v/coarse, loss scalars, v/image gradients and153 parameter gradients must exist for original comparator. Sequential counterparts exist transiently and are compared/released. X/G/Y/dX tensors must be observed to hash but need not be copied to persistent storage. No initial-weight serialization, all-layer activation/adjoint dump or all-step model snapshots.
observation.first_failure_report: Distinguish first nonzero observation from first original-threshold failure by declared graph dependencies. Report unobserved intervals and missing samples; do not infer causality merely from coarse scalar rounding.
observation.direct_call_estimate: For these unchanged requires_grad/dispatch assumptions only: static149 per forward/backward graph, estimated447 across64/32/32. This is not measured rank32 evidence or a count of indirect native BLAS; record actual per-path observations and reject unexplained mapping/call changes.

comparator.shape_dtype_finite_exact_rules: Original function byte-identical; no dropped categories or relaxed thresholds.
comparator.formal_update_AdamW_delta_buffer_restore: NOT_RUN by this zero-update diagnosis; all remain required for any later training gate, not replaced or waived.

proposed_resources.deadline_rule: Single monotonic start before preflight; execute only until common+240, cleanup until+270, close until+300. Per-path90 caps cannot reset common budget. No reservation/wait on compute node for missing prerequisites.
proposed_resources.retention: Keep one initial in-memory parameter snapshot, one B64 gradient/output/input-gradient reference set and transient sequential buffers; release graph and gradients between paths. Remote raw diagnostic artifacts only with path/bytes/SHA indexes; no raw/weights/data/env/ZIP in returned archive.
proposed_resources.feasibility: Conditional static envelope; actual peak memory/CPU availability not proved. Future reviewed implementation must supply a retention-size bound and passive observation mapping. If unavailable or cap cannot be respected, BLOCKED_SPEC_WITH_REASON before submission; runtime OOM/timeout stops without retry or resource increase.
